predecessors.name: Vakataka dynasty
predecessors.text: Kuntala: north Karnataka and south Maharashtra, taken from the Vakataka shape

successors.name: Chalukyas of Badami
successors.text: the Kadamba lands that Cliopatria's Chalukya shape of 555 covers

ledger.x: c. 345: Mayurasharma founds the Kadamba kingdom at Banavasi. 'The kingdom was founded by Mayurasharma in c. 345'; he went to Kanchi, quarrelled with a Pallava guard and left 'swearing vengeance on the Pallavas'; 'Mayurasharma defeated the armies of the Pallavas of Kanchi'; the Mayurasharma page: he established a…

c. 353: the Kadamba shape takes Kuntala from the Vakataka shape (451 cells). Kadamba page: Kangavarma (c. 365) 'had to fight the Vakataka might to protect his kingdom'; Bhageerath (c. 390) is described as retrieving his father's losses, though the Vakataka inscriptions do not confirm this. The Prithivishena I page…

c. 353: the rest of Mayurasharma's conquests (about 270 cells outside the Banavasi core). He 'subdued the Traikutas, the Abhiras, the Pariyathrakas, the Shakasthanas, the Maukharis' and the Brihad-Banas of Kolar; the Mayurasharma page adds the Sendrakas and Punnatas and the Pallava recognition of his sovereignty from…

c. 540: the Chalukyas of Badami, the Kadambas' own vassals, conquer the kingdom. Infobox 'Disestablished: 540'; 'Around c. 540 the Chalukyas who were vassals of the Kadambas and governed from Badami conquered the entire kingdom.' wars.name: Mayurasharma's revolt against the Pallavas
wars.outcome: Mayurasharma defeated the Pallava armies, subdued neighbouring tribes and was recognised as sovereign by the Pallava king Skandavarman from the western ocean to the Malaprabha.

wars.name: Kangavarma's war with the Vakatakas
wars.outcome: Kangavarma 'had to fight the Vakataka might to protect his kingdom'; no result is given.

wars.name: Raghu's war with the Pallavas
wars.outcome: Raghu 'died fighting the Pallavas in c.

wars.name: Ravivarma's war with the Vakatakas
wars.outcome: Ravivarma is credited with 'a victory against the Vakatakas' and a suzerainty over the Punnatas, Alupas, Kongalvas and the Pandyas of Uchangi.

wars.name: Krishnavarma II's reunification of the Kadambas
Chalukya conquest of the Kadambas
wars.outcome: The Chalukyas, vassals of the Kadambas at Badami, conquered the entire kingdom c.

certainty.note: The pages name regions (Banavasi, the Konkan, the Malaprabha) and no frontier line; the Kuntala border with the Vakataka and the southern border with the Gangas are the least certain.
